{{dablink|For other uses of the term "''Wheel of Time''," see ''[[Wheel of Time (disambiguation)|Wheel of Time]]''.}}
'''''Wheel of Time''''' is a song created by the band [[Wikipedia:Blind Guardian|Blind Guardian]] based on the [[The Wheel of Time|book series]] by [[Robert Jordan]]. It was a song featured in their album "At the Edge of Time."

==Analysis==
The song is from the point of view of [[Rand al'Thor]] with possible mentions to [[Lews Therin Telamon]] inside his head, as well as thoughts on his own possible madness.
